 into :don_comm.comm_type_desc;
 if cur_comtp%NOTFOUND then
 :don_comm.comm_type_desc := 'NA';

 end if;

 end if;
 else

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DONOR_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*********
 Modified and Verified for Y2K ......YPG....06/09
*********/
PROCEDURE get_donor_info 
 (p_donor_id in varchar2) IS

 szFirstName varchar2(50) := '';
 szMiddleName varchar2(50) := '';
 szLastName varchar2(50) := '';
 szLastNameSuffix varchar2(50) := '';
 szGender varchar2(6) := '';
 v_SSN number := 0 ;
 szABODESC varchar2(50) := '';
 szDOB date ;
 szSSNMode NUMBER;

 cursor cur_donor is
 select a.first_name,
 a.middle_name,
 a.last_name,
 nvl(a.last_name_suffix, ''),
 decode(a.gender, 'M', 'Male', 'F', 'Female', ''), 
 --a.ssn,
 a.date_of_birth,
 b.description
 from donors a, valid_master_codes b
 where a.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and b.code_type = 'ABO'
 and b.code = nvl(a.blood_type, 'NONE')
 --MS and a.chapter_id = 'ALL';
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, a.chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id; --MS (IM# 4869)
 --and a.chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id;

BEGIN
 IF p_donor_id is not null then
 open cur_donor;
 fetch cur_donor
 into szFirstName,
 szMiddleName,
 szLastName,
 szLastNameSuffix,
 szGender,
 --v_SSN,
 szDOB,
 szABODESC;
 If cur_donor%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_donor;
 Else


 -- :ctrl_block.donor_ssn := nSSN;
 :ctrl_block.donor_name := initcap(szLastName) || ', ' || 
 initcap(szFirstName) || ' ' || 
 initcap(szMiddleName);
 :ctrl_block.donor_sex := initcap(szGender);
 :ctrl_block.donor_dob := to_char(szDOB, 'MM-DD-YYYY');
 :ctrl_block.donor_abo := initcap(substr(szABODESC, 1, 6));
 End if;
 if cur_donor%isopen then
 close cur_donor;
 end if;
 End if;
 --pitss synchronize;
END;

PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, '#' || :parameter.p_donor_id || '##');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 --call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
 call_form( lower(p_window_name), HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

PROCEDURE gp_constructor IS
 list_id ITEM;
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20):='COM';
 rg_id RecordGroup;
 errcode Number;

BEGIN
 
 rg_id:=find_group(rg_name);
 if not ID_Null(rg_id) then
 delete_group(rg_id);
 end if;
 rg_id:= Create_Group_from_Query( rg_name, 'SELECT distinct com_type column1,com_type column2 ' 
 ||'FROM DONOR_COMMUNICATIONS ' 
 ||'WHERE DONOR_ID=:parameter.p_donor_id ' 
 ||' and com_type not in ( ' || in_quotes('COMTP') || ', ' 
 || in_quotes('ACTCD') || ', ' || in_quotes('NOTFY') || ')' );
 errcode:=populate_group(rg_id);

 list_id:=find_item('ctrl_block.com_type');
 Delete_List_Element(list_id,1);
 POpulate_list(list_id,rg_id);

END;
